title: 第1357章 复活复活第1356章 你小子够狠
content_zh:
毒母巨剑虽然没有任何特殊能力，但它有一个其他奇物无法比拟的优势——硬度。
它是万界位面最坚硬的物质，足以承载六种序列之力的同时加持而不崩溃，足以承载楚夏九阶巅峰修为的全力爆发而不碎裂。
这就是最纯粹的武器。
不需要任何花哨的能力，不需要任何复杂的阵法，只需要够硬、够重、够锋利，就够了。
楚夏深吸一口气。
体内所有的力量在这一刻全部涌入剑身之中。
六种序列之力、一百零八位大帝道韵、九阶巅峰修为的混沌主宰之力、群星闪耀套装的星辰之力，所有的力量都毫无保留地灌注进这柄通体漆黑的巨剑之中。
毒母巨剑发出了一声前所未有的嗡鸣，那声音沉重而雄浑，如同亿万颗星辰在宇宙深处同时共振。
剑身上浮现出无数道混沌色的纹路，那些纹路不断蔓延交织，最终将整柄剑都染成了一种深邃到了极致的混沌之色。
楚夏猛然踏前一步。
脚下的深坑底部被他这一踏之力踩得直接塌陷，无数道裂纹以他的脚底为中心向四面八方蔓延。
他双手握剑，以一个最简单、最直接、最没有任何花哨的姿态，朝着肯塔乌当头劈下。
一剑，就一剑。
楚夏所有的力量，在这一剑中完全爆发出来。
刹那间，天地失色。
灰紫色的天穹在这一剑之下变得一片漆黑，不是夜幕降临的黑，而是连光本身都被剑气湮灭的绝对黑暗。
大地在这一剑之下无声无息地蒸发，深坑的底部再次向下塌陷了千丈，塌陷的岩壁光滑如镜，没有一丝裂纹，因为所有接触剑气的物质都在瞬间被分解成了最微小的粒子。
大道在这一剑之下开始磨灭。
虚妄大陆的天道法则在疯狂的哀鸣，无数道法则锁链在剑气中寸寸崩碎，化作最原始的法则碎片四散飞溅。
时间被剑气斩得支离破碎，空间被剑气撕得千疮百孔，因果线在这一剑之下全部断裂，命运长河在这一剑之下被搅得天翻地覆。

整个虚妄大陆的生灵都在这一剑的威压下恐惧得瑟瑟发抖。
那些藏在群山深处的奇兽匍匐在地，瑟瑟发抖，连呼吸都不敢发出一丝声响。
那些在黄沙废墟中苟延残喘的试炼者们跪倒在地，朝着剑气的方向疯狂叩首，仿佛在面对一尊足以毁灭世界的末日之神。
剑气掠过天穹，天空出现了一条不见尽头的剑痕。
那剑痕从楚夏剑锋的位置一直延伸到天际的尽头，宽度足有万丈开外，剑痕内部是一片纯粹的虚无——没有时间、没有空间、没有法则、没有物质，什么都没有，只有一片连存在都被抹去的绝对真空。
天穹被这一剑硬生生劈成了两半。
肯塔乌站在剑气之前，那双纯白色的眼眸中第一次出现了凝重的神色。
他想要避开剑气的锋芒，但下一瞬间，他的脸色就变了。
他发现，自己根本无法避开。
这道剑气已经将他完全锁定。
不是空间层面的锁定，不是时间层面的锁定，不是因果层面的锁定，而是一种更加本质的、直接作用于存在本身的锁定。
只要他存在于这个世上，只要他还是虚妄之神肯塔乌，这道剑气就会追着他，穿过时间、空间、因果、命运，穿过一切障碍，最终斩在他的身上。
无处可逃，无路可退，无法规避，只能硬接。
“好小子！”
肯塔乌的声音中满是惊怒，“老夫倒是小瞧了你！”
content_en:
Although the Poison Mother Greatsword does not have any special abilities, it has an advantage that other strange objects cannot match - its hardness.
It is the hardest material in the plane of the world. It is strong enough to bear the simultaneous blessing of six sequences without collapsing. It is strong enough to bear the full burst of Chu Xia's ninth-order peak cultivation without breaking into pieces.
This is the purest weapon.
It doesn't require any fancy abilities or complicated formations, it just needs to be hard enough, heavy enough, and sharp enough.
Chu Xia took a deep breath.
All the power in the body poured into the sword at this moment.
The power of the six sequences, the Tao Yun of one hundred and eight great emperors, the power of the Chaos Master with the ninth level of peak cultivation, and the power of the stars from the Shining Stars Suit, all the power was poured into this pitch-black giant sword without any reservation.
The Poison Mother Giant Sword made an unprecedented hum, the sound was heavy and powerful, like billions of stars resonating simultaneously in the depths of the universe.
剑身上浮现出无数道混沌色的纹路，那些纹路不断蔓延交织，最终将整柄剑都染成了一种深邃到了极致的混沌之色。
Chu Xia suddenly took a step forward.
The bottom of the pit beneath his feet collapsed directly with the force of his step, and countless cracks spread in all directions centered on the soles of his feet.
He held the sword with both hands and struck Kentau head-on with the simplest, most direct, and least fancy gesture.
One sword, just one sword.
All Chu Xia's power completely exploded in this sword.
In an instant, the sky and the earth turned pale.
The gray-purple sky turned pitch black under this sword, not the darkness of nightfall, but the absolute darkness where even the light itself was annihilated by the sword energy.
大地在这一剑之下无声无息地蒸发，深坑的底部再次向下塌陷了千丈，塌陷的岩壁光滑如镜，没有一丝裂纹，因为所有接触剑气的物质都在瞬间被分解成了最微小的粒子。
The avenue began to disappear under this sword.
The heavenly laws of the False Continent were wailing crazily, and countless law chains were shattered inch by inch in the sword energy, turning into the most primitive law fragments and flying everywhere.
时间被剑气斩得支离破碎，空间被剑气撕得千疮百孔，因果线在这一剑之下全部断裂，命运长河在这一剑之下被搅得天翻地覆。
All the creatures in the False Continent were trembling in fear under the pressure of this sword.
Those strange beasts hidden deep in the mountains were lying on the ground, shivering, not even daring to make a sound while breathing.
Those trialists who were lingering in the ruins of the yellow sand knelt on the ground and kowtowed frantically in the direction of the sword energy, as if they were facing a god of doom that could destroy the world.
The sword energy swept across the sky, and an endless sword mark appeared in the sky.
The sword mark extends from the position of Chu Xia's sword to the end of the sky, with a width of ten thousand feet. Inside the sword mark is pure nothingness - no time, no space, no rules, no matter, nothing, only an absolute vacuum in which even existence has been erased.
The sky was cut in half by this sword.
Kentau stood in front of the sword energy, and for the first time a solemn look appeared in his pure white eyes.
He wanted to avoid the edge of the sword energy, but in the next moment, his expression changed.
He found that he couldn't avoid it at all.
This sword energy has completely locked him.
It is not a lock on the spatial level, not a lock on the time level, not a lock on the causal level, but a more essential lock that directly affects existence itself.
As long as he exists in this world, as long as he is still the god of illusion, Kentau, this sword energy will chase him, passing through time, space, cause and effect, destiny, passing through all obstacles, and finally slashing on him.
There is nowhere to escape, no way to retreat, no way to avoid it, only to take it hard.
"Good boy!"
Kentau's voice was full of surprise.Angry, "I underestimated you!"
